name: AllUnity EUR
oneLiner: EURAU is AllUnity's MiCA-licensed euro stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 against EUR held in full-reserve, segregated accounts at EU credit institutions.
collateral: Euro-denominated reserves held at CRR credit institutions within the EU, under a multi-bank full reserve model; not used for lending or investment

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: AllUnity describes EURAU as fully backed by bank reserves and provides always-on settlement. Its white paper permits EUR cash and HQLA reserves for a 1:1 euro claim, which supports the issuer-managed fiat-cash archetype rather than a CDP, NAV fund share, or algorithmic mechanism.

mintAuthority.summary: EURAU uses the same uncapped EOA minter and EOA DEFAULT_ADMIN across all six EVM deployments; the admin can grant roles, pause, and immediately upgrade the UUPS logic. Solana issuance is delegated to an AllUnity program-controlled Token-2022 mint authority, while AllUnity's regulated issuer backend controls the off-chain issuance workflow and other native lanes. The previously modeled Stellar issuer string is checksum-invalid and was removed rather than treated as a controller.

sources.label: BNB Chain EURAU proxy at block 111262337

controls.label: EURAU EOA MINTER_ROLE (all EVM chains)
controls.evidence: Fresh hasRole reads confirm this codeless address is the sole MINTER_ROLE holder at Ethereum block 25712415, Arbitrum 492496443, Optimism 155309746, Base 49714461, Polygon 91675496, and BNB Chain 114795046. The verified mint function has no numeric supply ceiling, so its direct ability is economically unbounded; the minter itself cannot change role administration or upgrade logic.

controls.label: EURAU EOA DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (all EVM chains)
controls.evidence: Fresh hasRole reads confirm this codeless address holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and PAUSER_ROLE at Ethereum block 25712415, Arbitrum 492496443, Optimism 155309746, Base 49714461, Polygon 91675496, and BNB Chain 114795046. Every proxy still resolves to implementation 0x56c19aea2192ff0ac5f6b252776480db601a1482, whose _authorizeUpgrade is DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE-gated with no ProxyAdmin or timelock. It can grant new minters or replace mint logic immediately.

controls.label: EURAU Solana Token-2022 program mint authority
controls.evidence: At finalized slot 438052335, the Token-2022 EURAU mint reports this program-owned account as mint authority, freeze authority, permanent delegate, and pausable-config authority (paused=false). The authority can issue without a numeric token cap but cannot independently change the EVM role graph.

controls.label: AllUnity regulated issuance backend
controls.evidence: AllUnity operates EURAU business-account minting and redemption as the BaFin-authorized EMT issuer across its native chain lanes. The backend controls the uncapped EVM minter and Solana authority workflow, so it can originate issuance and raise the effective amount without consuming a fixed on-chain allowance.

review.evidence: Fresh 2026-08-08 reads show the same EOA minter and EOA DEFAULT_ADMIN/PAUSER on all six EVM deployments at Ethereum block 25712415, Arbitrum 492496443, Optimism 155309746, Base 49714461, Polygon 91675496, and BNB Chain 114795046; all implementation slots remain 0x56c19aea2192ff0ac5f6b252776480db601a1482 and paused() is false. Solana finalized slot 438052335 identifies the program-owned APJqyTzEng2jeLoyvRSZYgTpaZDBdxMetkvUSmvRMbTP as mint/freeze/permanent-delegate authority. The invalid Stellar issuer string was removed: Horizon rejects it and the only discoverable EURAU assets have unrelated issuers. AllUnity's whitepaper describes regular internal and external reserve audits and regulatory reporting, supporting periodic reconciliation, although its Trust Center still has no public dated reserve audit report. ESMA/BaFin primary records support the existing prudential-supervision classification.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AllUnity says EURAU integrates Chainlink CCIP for native zero-slippage burn/mint transfers across supported chains. Because durable cross-chain supply movement depends on CCIP's external interoperability network and issuer controls, the route is scored as external-validated-network.
